text: 10 OVERDOSAGE A specific reversal agent for edoxaban is not available. Overdose of SAVAYSA increases the risk of bleeding. The following are not expected to reverse the anticoagulant effects of edoxaban: protamine sulfate, vitamin K, and tranexamic acid [see Warnings and Precautions (5.3) ] . Hemodialysis does not significantly contribute to edoxaban clearance [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.3) ] .
